hypothesis: The unchanged geometry-Gaussian/Fourier rule yields repeatable scoped engineering and distribution benefits beyond equal-capacity uniform Gaussian and complete half-Fourier controls on T1/S1. Prior S1 common-refresh 1600 primary improvement and T1 common-refresh 800 U/stress-distribution improvement are prespecified targets for replication.
primary_contrasts: S1 common-refresh 1600 U/S/wall versus both controls
T1 common-refresh 800 U/S, U/S MAE and p95 versus both controls; wall and convergence trade-offs reported
all_other_contrasts: All cases, both arms, both fixed endpoints, regions, quantiles, geometry-defined engineering points and targets retained. No selective endpoint, arm, seed or metric-weight selection.
training_rule: Reuse the exact frozen train_p2i implementation and all geometry/material/feature/loss/optimizer/sampling rules. Only seed and output/protocol paths change. 24 fresh trajectories, 1600 accepted steps each, four matched-reset 400-step blocks; 96 saved states, 48 evaluated endpoints. Both seeds must finish before reference-array evaluation.
reference_rule: Reuse byte-verified P2J reference arrays and both independent physical sets, with the verified precision-aware geometry-only wall rule. No additional FEM repair, model selection or tuning.
summary: Show the two new seeds separately as prospective replication, then descriptive pooled three-seed paired ratios (geometric mean, range, favorable count), arithmetic means and each seed. No statistical-significance or unseen-geometry claim from n=3. Include full error distribution/spatial coverage, engineering and resources.
decision: A scoped benefit is repeated only if the named error or distribution measure favors geometry against both controls in BOTH new seeds; report per-measure outcomes without a combined score. Multimetric S1 headline requires all three primary metrics in both new seeds; T1 headline requires U/S and specified MAE/p95 in both. Failures narrow the claim; no retries, extra seeds or tuning. Do not demand every exploratory metric wins.
stop: Close after 24 trajectories and all 48 evaluated fields; stop dependent work on nonfinite/early optimizer stop or numerical/hash failure. No new architecture search or added budgets in this batch.
